_source: Placement library (4/N). Bhava themes keyed "1".."12". Used by InterpretationService to name the life area a placement acts in, so the reading can say WHERE a planet operates without an LLM. Payload { text }. English-authored; run `npm run kb:backfill -- --tables=house-meaning` for the other 11 locales.

en.text: Self, body, vitality and the impression you make before you speak. The lagna sets the tone every other house is read against.
Accumulated wealth, family lineage, speech and what you value. Money already earned rather than money being earned.
Courage, initiative, siblings, short journeys and the skill of your own hands. The house of self-effort.
Home, mother, inner peace, land and vehicles. The foundation you return to when the day is done.
Intelligence, children, creativity, romance and purva punya — the merit you arrived with.
Debt, disease, competition and daily service. Difficult by nature, but the house where discipline defeats obstacles.
Marriage, partnership and every formal agreement with another. The mirror house, directly opposite the self.
Longevity, upheaval, inheritance, the occult and joint resources. Sudden change, and what survives it.
Dharma, fortune, father, guru, higher learning and long journeys. Classically the most auspicious house.
Career, status, authority and visible action in the world. What you are known for publicly.
Gains, income, networks, elder siblings and fulfilled desires. Where effort converts into reward.
Loss, expenditure, foreign lands, seclusion and moksha. Release — costly when unconscious, liberating when chosen.
